what_happened.line: The Municipal Building Design Committee took no votes and spent most of the meeting hearing two former Building Reuse Committee members on past decisions about Town Hall and Ritter.
Members split into pairs to pull must-do repairs, with page citations, from the Vertex and TAPE reports on Town Hall and Ritter, for review at the next meeting.
A member said the town cannot bear a full renovation of TC Pacios, so work must stay under the threshold that triggers code upgrades.
The committee said the old primary school demolition is a separate article, with asbestos abatement already in the capital plan and ARPA funds a possible way to avoid debt.
The committee set April 4 as the next meeting, moved the second to April 13, and added May 16; a member will draft a town meeting handout.

why_it_matters: The committee's choice of which repairs are must-do on Ritter and Town Hall will shape what building proposal residents are later asked to vote on at town meeting and fund through taxes or debt.
The committee is working to a self-imposed building budget limit, so the cost of the proposal depends on whether new revenue or ARPA funds are applied.
